key_catalyst: U.S.-Iran military escalation with Strait of Hormuz tanker traffic down 52% and CPI due July 15 that could trigger Fed action
reasoning: All three catalysts remain actively escalating: U.S.-Iran strikes are in their third consecutive night with tanker traffic through Hormuz down 52% and Brent above $85, Fed Governor Waller explicitly warned a hot CPI print on July 15 could trigger a near-term hike, and the AI/semiconductor selloff intensified with the Kospi plunging 8.9%. Despite the market closing essentially flat on July 14 (+0.04% intraday), this muted response appears to reflect pre-CPI complacency rather than genuine absorption of a worsening geopolitical and inflationary backdrop.
